title: 13 Squid Arctic Ice Cold Double Menthol 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Arctic Ice Cold Double Menthol from 13 Squid is a must for any menthol lover. This exquisite e-liquid delivers the rush of pure, crisp menthol with a subtle, floral sweetness from spearmint, delivering a vape experience that’s smooth, refreshing and utterly moreish. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks , producing rich clouds and immaculate flavour.
